nl: Write the relative paths of all .md files in docs/ (recursively) to docs-index.txt, one path per line, sorted, with '/' as separator and without a leading './'.
oracle_program: find "docs" glob: "**/*.md" type: file sort: name |> select relative |> write "docs-index.txt" format: lines
reference_bash: find docs -type f -name '*.md' | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort > docs-index.txt
